name: xenium_production
description: Xenium ulcerative colitis (Mennillo et al.; Figshare 27327813 Dataset 1): 581,967 cells x 290 genes, one model per patient-condition/timepoint unit (25), 6-NN graph within each slide/core. Paper protocol, K = 12, five seeds, all genes (targeted panel), penalty grid widened to 50 values (top 1e-4 * 1.2^49 ~ 0.76) because the original benchmark selected the top of the 29-value grid in every Xenium fit. Build data with scripts/data/prepare_xenium.py --download.
